about: Vernon is the principal city of the North Okanagan, between Okanagan Lake and Kalamalka Lake in British Columbia’s Interior. It is a service, orchard, and recreation centre with a compact downtown and beaches on both lakes. Hills, vineyards, and ranch country wrap the city. About 45,000 people live in Vernon.
seoSummary: North Okanagan city between Okanagan Lake and turquoise Kalamalka Lake.
knownFor: Kalamalka Lake, the “lake of a thousand colours”
